description: This file defines a configuration class for the auditor aware service in a Spring application, which retrieves the current auditor's ID from the API request context.

classes.name: AuditorAwareConfig
classes.description: Configuration class implementing AuditorAware to provide current auditor information based on the API request context.

methods.name: getCurrentAuditor
methods.description: Provides the current auditor's ID, defaulting to 'SYSTEM_USER' if the auth ID is unavailable.
